title: Generate architecture views for a customer project
goal: Obtain attributable architecture views for the selected project.
context: The author has a supported customer model using its own identities.
trigger: The author needs to inspect or share the architecture.
preconditions: The selected scope and any available project or artifact identity are explicitly identified.

interaction.action: Selects the project, declared profile and intended output.
Presents generated view entry points, selected-state identity and any missing optional detail.
Navigates a view and requests its source explanation.
Shows the selected definition, relationships and provenance without project-specific assumptions.

expected_outcome: The author can inspect the selected customer architecture without requiring RigorLoop project content.

alternatives.outcome: The Process entry reports the missing detail without inventing sequence.

failures.outcome: The selection is diagnosed and no successful snapshot is published.

sources.locator: SCN-083; confirmed as requirement-analysis knowledge by the scoped author assessment, not independent review or executed product proof.
sources.basis: User-requested reusable customer architecture browser; requirement-level author analysis. Current records remain draft; no implemented, published or independently approved behavior is claimed.
